# Siliguri Freshmart

> Premium fresh fish, chicken, mutton, vegetables and essentials delivered to your doorstep in Siliguri. Same-day delivery, free above ₹299.

## About
Siliguri Freshmart is an online fresh fish and meat delivery service based in Siliguri, West Bengal, India. We deliver fresh fish, chicken, mutton, pork, seafood, vegetables, fruits, dairy and daily essentials. Everything is sourced fresh each morning from Siliguri's local markets, packed in insulated bags and delivered directly to your doorstep — no middlemen, no frozen storage.

## Categories
- [Fresh Fish](https://www.siligurifreshmart.com/category/fish): Rohu, Katla, Hilsa, Prawns, Pabda, Tangra and more — daily fresh from local markets
- [Chicken](https://www.siligurifreshmart.com/category/chicken): Farm-fresh broiler and country chicken, cut to order
- [Mutton](https://www.siligurifreshmart.com/category/mutton): Premium goat mutton, curry cut and keema
- [Vegetables](https://www.siligurifreshmart.com/category/vegetables): Seasonal and farm-fresh vegetables
- [Fruits](https://www.siligurifreshmart.com/category/fruits): Fresh seasonal fruits
- [Dairy & Eggs](https://www.siligurifreshmart.com/category/dairy): Milk, curd, paneer, eggs
- [Groceries](https://www.siligurifreshmart.com/category/groceries): Rice, dal, oil, spices and daily essentials
- [Durga Puja Special](https://www.siligurifreshmart.com/durgapuja): Fresh fish and meat delivery for Durga Puja (Shashthi to Dashami)

## Delivery Info
- Same-day delivery across a 20 km radius of our hub at MCQF+GFQ, Siliguri
- Delivery time by distance: within 4 km ~1 hour; within 8 km 1–2 hours; 8–16 km Morning Slot (order before 11 AM, delivered 11 AM–1 PM); 16–20 km Afternoon Slot (order before 2 PM, delivered 2 PM–3 PM)
- Free delivery on orders above ₹299 (within 8 km); no minimum within 4 km
- Delivery fee: ₹59 (below ₹99 within 8 km), ₹40 (₹99–₹298), Free (₹299+); 8–16 km ₹79 below ₹1,499; 16–20 km ₹100 below ₹1,999
- GPS location required at checkout to calculate distance, time and fees
- Payment: Cash on Delivery (COD), UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), cards, netbanking
